title: Darbar se jab
body:
darbar se jab aayi ghar beti nabi ki roti rahi
ek din nahi phir umr bhai beti nabi ki roti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jeene diya kab chain se ummat ne dhaaye itne sitam
jhutlaya us tehreer ko jo de gaye thay shaahe umam
haste rahe sab ahle shar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir aag le kar ahle shar zehra ke darwaze par gaye
dar bhi jala ghar bhi jala sab gham sahe thay rote huwe
jis dam gira pehlu pe dar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu bhi ek zakhmi hua pehlu se haye tha khoon rawan
ro kar sada baba ko di tooti jo zehra ki phasliyan
is dard mein shaam o sahar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke bas roti rahi mohsin bhi mera maara gaya
bhoolungi mai kaise usay ye gham mujhe bas kha jayega
is baat par sar peet kar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghusl o kafan dete huwe sher e khuda bhi rone lage
pehlu ko jab dekha kiye sher e khuda bhi rone lage
ab ye khula kyun umr bhar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar nahi taabe bayan mazhar karega ab kya raqam
lafzon mein kya kar payge koi bayan ye bibi ke gham
hai marsiya bas ek satar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
author: Mazhar Abidi
